archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & INSTITUTIONAL FINANCIAL TERMINAL (High-Precision Dark Command Center)

design_philosophy.core_identity: E1 The Anti-AI Designer fusion: Bloomberg Terminal precision + Swiss Horology typography + Lionsbit Sovereign Wealth gold & midnight obsidian aesthetic.
design_philosophy.background_foundation: Deep Obsidian (#060B13 / #0A0F1D) with hairline structural borders (#1E293B / #334155 / rgba(212,175,55,0.18)) and subtle champagne-gold micro-accents (#D4AF37 / #E5C158). No muddy full-screen gradients. Clean, razor-sharp, data-dense execution.
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Institutional trust, mathematical rigor, Swiss banking discretion, uncompromising execution speed.
prohibitions: NO generic light gray cards inside the MT5 terminal
NO unstyled raw tables without tabular-nums and fixed column width discipline
NO numbers wrapping or overflowing (enforce truncate, tabular-nums, max-w, tooltip on hover)
NO hidden state badges: Demo status must remain permanently visible with golden amber/badge tagging
NO generic purple/violet tech gradients; use Obsidian (#060B13), Lionsbit Navy (#0E1E38), Regulated Green (#0ECB81), Order Book Red (#F6465D), and Lionsbit Champagne Gold (#D4AF37)

font_pairings.headings: Poppins, -apple-system, sans-serif (font-bold, tracking-tight, uppercase subheadings with tracking-[0.2em])

scale.section_h2: text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-slate-300
scale.kpi_label: text-[10px] sm:text-[10.5px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] font-semibold text-slate-400
scale.kpi_value: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-[26px] font-bold tabular-nums font-mono text-white leading-tight

tokens.card_style: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0A111F] via-[#0E182A] to-[#080E1A] border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl shadow-[0_4px_24px_-8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)]
tokens.gold_pill: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] bg-[#D4AF37]/15 text-[#F3D372] border border-[#D4AF37]/35 shadow-[0_0_14px_rgba(212,175,55,0.2)]
tokens.status_badge_connected: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30
tokens.status_badge_demo: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30
tokens.status_badge_syncing: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/30 animate-pulse

level_1_header.description: Executive MT5 Institutional Header bar with Lionsbit crest / gold trim, account number with one-click copy, live status indicator ('Conectado' / 'Sincronizando' / 'Demo' / 'Desconectado'), sync button with spin micro-interaction, and fast link to Regulation/Broker.
badges_required: Status: CONECTADO / DEMO (Clear explicit tag if simulated data)

level_2_kpi_dashboard.description: High-density 5-metric financial ribbon. No text wrapping. Numbers formatted with tabular-nums and strict overflow guards.
level_2_kpi_dashboard.responsive_behavior: Desktop 5-column grid or 4+1 layout. Mobile snap carousel with visible index indicator dots and compact swipe cards.

level_3_navigation_tabs.description: Explicit top-level terminal tabs as requested: Trading (default), Fondos, Historial, Regulación (plus Inversión Cripto / Feeds seamlessly accessible).

tabs.label: Trading Terminal
tabs.description: Chart grande, Market Watch institucional, Panel Buy/Sell, Posiciones y Órdenes

tabs.label: Fondos & Transferencias
tabs.description: Depósito desde Wallet, Retiro de margen libre, Historial de transferencias

tabs.label: Historial & Reportes
tabs.description: Historial de operaciones cerradas con filtros, Curva de Equity y Statement

tabs.label: Regulación & Seguridad
tabs.description: Broker regulado eToro CNMV/CySEC/FCA, Protección Europea MiFID II/ICF, Verificador en vivo

tabs.label: Inversión Cripto
tabs.description: Abono profesional USDT/BTC/ETH, seguimiento on-chain y liquidación

level_4_trading_workspace.layout_desktop: Asymmetric 12-column institutional split: Left 4-cols = Market Watch with category filters, bid/ask, spread & instant action. Right 8-cols = Dominant Chart (lightweight-charts) with timeframe switcher, live 1s tick, SL/TP visual lines and R:R calculator panel.

order_panel.type: Professional Buy/Sell modal & inline trigger with lot stepper, automatic margin required calculation, pip value display, and instant validation.

bottom_dock.description: Sub-tabbed operations dock right below the chart: [Posiciones Abiertas (con cierre parcial y SL/TP editables)] | [Órdenes Pendientes] | [Journal de Auditoría].
bottom_dock.table_treatment: Strict column sizing, monospace tabular-nums, sticky headers, zero horizontal scroll jitter, explicit Buy/Sell direction pill.

number_overflow_prevention_rules.rule_1_tabular_nums: Every financial number MUST have 'font-mono tabular-nums tracking-tight'.
number_overflow_prevention_rules.rule_2_fixed_decimals: Currencies must use exactly 2 decimals ($12,345.67). Prices use 2 to 5 decimals depending on pip granularity. Never leave unbounded floating point decimals (e.g., 1.0849200000001).
number_overflow_prevention_rules.rule_3_responsive_clamping: Use text-lg sm:text-xl md:text-2xl on balances with 'truncate max-w-full' to prevent card explosion on narrow viewports.
number_overflow_prevention_rules.rule_4_symbol_ticket_formatting: Tickets always have '#' prefix (#1084291). Symbols uppercase font-bold monospace ('EURUSD', 'BTCUSD').

simulated_data_compliance.rule: Every mock/demo data element MUST display a visible badge: 'MODO DEMO' or 'SIMULACIÓN' in amber/gold, with an informative tooltip stating 'Datos simulados para fines de demostración técnica · MT5 Bridge real en producción'.
simulated_data_compliance.disclaimer_text: Los datos de mercado y ejecución operan en entorno Demo institucional. Conexión de puente FIX / WebSocket lista para producción.

trading_terminal_desktop.description: Multi-monitor financial trading terminal desk for institutional background or modal headers

gold_emblem.description: Brass-gold heraldic lion insignia representing sovereign institutional custody

motion_and_interactions.tick_flash: Duration 400ms text color transition: Emerald (#0ECB81) on uptick, Rose (#F6465D) on downtick, settling back to white.
motion_and_interactions.sync_spin: Refresh button spins on click with linear easing while syncing=true.
motion_and_interactions.tab_switching: Smooth instantaneous switch with subtle fade-in translateY(4px) without jarring scroll shifts.
motion_and_interactions.interactive_price_lines: Dragging SL/TP shows vertical ns-resize cursor and updates live R:R preview in real time.

accessibility_and_apca.contrast_standards: All text labels on slate-900/950 meet WCAG AA / APCA standards. Muted labels are at least text-slate-400 (#94A3B8) or text-slate-300 (#CBD5E1), never invisible dark gray.
accessibility_and_apca.touch_targets: Minimum 44px tap target height on mobile for all trading action buttons (BUY, SELL, Sync, Tab switches).
accessibility_and_apca.testing_ids: All interactive triggers and metric fields must feature unique data-testid attributes (e.g. 'mt5-page', 'mt5-account-login', 'mt5-status-pill', 'mt5-kpi-balance', 'mt5-chart', 'mt5-order-buy-btn', 'mt5-tab-trading', 'mt5-tab-funds', 'mt5-tab-history', 'mt5-tab-regulation').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Restructure the MT5Page.jsx header to display an elite institutional terminal look with Lionsbit gold accents, account #, status pill ('CONECTADO' / 'DEMO' / 'SINCRONIZANDO'), and quick sync.
2. Render the 5-metric KPI dashboard with crystal-clear typography, tabular-nums, no number wrapping, and clear subtext.

3. Enforce the user's explicit request: Separate content into top-level tabs: Trading (Market Watch + Big Chart + Positions/Orders/Journal), Fondos (Deposit/Withdraw), Historial (Closed Operations + Statement + Equity Curve), Regulación (Broker eToro + CNMV/CySEC licenses + MiFID II/ICF + Validation Modal), plus Crypto Investment.
4. Make the MT5 candlestick chart larger (min height 480px on desktop) with prominent timeframes (M1, M15, H1, D1), EMA 21, tick 1s polling, interactive SL/TP dragging, and the 2% risk rule preview.
5. Keep Market Watch organized with categories (Forex, Metales, Cripto, Índices, Energía), search filter, bid/ask spread, and direct Buy/Sell trigger buttons.
6. Format all numbers strictly using helper utilities (fmtMoney, fmtPrice, fmtNum) to eliminate any overflow or uncontrolled decimal chains.

7. Preserve full connectivity with existing backend endpoints (/mt5/summary, /mt5/symbols, /mt5/candles, /mt5/tick, /mt5/order, /mt5/positions, /mt5/deposit, /mt5/withdraw, /mt5/broker/verify, /mt5-hub/*).
8. Clearly mark simulated demo data with an explicit gold/amber 'DEMO' pill.
